target.statement: FM-DS-V4 achieves 70.2% accuracy on LongBench-v2-S (46K) with 0.04 GB GPU KV cache, versus DS-V4-Flash at 68.9% with 0.17 GB.

compute.basis: The target requires the hundred-billion-parameter DeepSeek-V4-Flash/Pro backbone, the LSA memory-indexer checkpoint, and the custom PD-disaggregated CPU-GPU serving stack, which the paper measures only on an 8×H20 server.

blockers: Requires a massive DeepSeek-V4-Flash/Pro backbone model, not runnable on a laptop
Requires 8×H20-class GPU serving infrastructure for the reported deployment path
Custom CUDA-graph/PD-disaggregated SGLang offload implementation is needed and the project is suspended
Complete configurations and training/eval recipes appear unavailable due to project suspension
The reported KV-cache numbers depend on GPU memory accounting from the serving stack, not just model inference
title: FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4: Lightning Index Ultra-Long Context via Lookahead Sparse Attention
